turnaround_reason: Coty was beaten down to ~$1.82 on weak consumer-beauty demand, a slowing prestige-fragrance market, and a heavy debt load; the stock has re-rated ~44% in 30 days as management deleverages (net debt at a 9-year low), repaid its 2026 maturities, and returned the Gucci Beauty license to Kering for ~$400M to cut debt and refocus on core prestige fragrance.
bullish_points: Fragrance is >60% of revenue and an even larger share of profit; prestige fragrance remains one of the more resilient beauty categories
Balance sheet actively improving: net debt lowest in 9 years, 2026 bonds repaid, ~$400M Gucci license sale earmarked for debt paydown, positive FCF (~$403M TTM)
Management guides a return to growth in 2H FY26 with FY26 adjusted EBITDA of ~$838-848M; forward P/E ~8.3x is undemanding for a deleveraging cash generator
Insiders/JAB hold ~59% of shares, aligning sponsor incentives with recovery
bearish_points: Q2 FY26 missed EPS ($0.14 vs $0.18 est); prestige LFL -2% and consumer beauty -6% show demand has NOT inflected yet
Revenue still shrinking (-1.3% TTM); the 'return to growth' is a guide, not a print
EV ~$6B on ~$2.5B market cap = highly levered equity stub; small changes in EBITDA swing equity value hard
The easy money may be gone — stock already ran ~44% in 30 days, so entry now is chasing a recovering-mode move
Options open interest is thin (call OI ~6k) and the sampled ATM IV field looks like bad data
catalyst: Q3/Q4 FY26 prints demonstrating the guided 2H return to revenue growth plus continued deleveraging from the Gucci proceeds
catalyst_timing: Q3 FY26 earnings (spring 2026, already reported mixed) and Q4/FY26 results late summer 2026
suggested_trade: Small spot starter only; prefer to add on a pullback toward the low-$2s rather than chase the 44% pop. Not an options name given thin OI.
key_risk: Consumer-beauty weakness deepens and the 2H growth inflection fails to show, leaving a still-levered equity de-rating from a stretched short-term move
would_skip_if: No revenue inflection by Q4 FY26, or fragrance market softens; also skip if forced to chase above ~$3.20 without a pullback
